init.title: Entity and platform options
init.description: Choose which openHAB platforms are enabled. You can also disable helper or unwanted Items. Filter changes are applied automatically when you press Submit.

data.sensor: Enable sensors (DateTime, Number and String Items)

data_description.excluded_item_prefixes: Enter one or more prefixes separated by commas. Every openHAB Item whose name starts with one of these values will be disabled in Home Assistant. Example: nl_, nt_, nc_
data_description.excluded_item_names: Enter one or more exact Item names separated by commas. Only openHAB Items with exactly these names will be disabled. Example: ndim, ncurtin, nhvac
